title: White Cliffs of Dover with DJI MAVIC PRO
description:
We went to Kent for the weekend and planned to visit the cliffs, I just HAD to take my Mavic with me at jump at the opportunity. Unfortunately it was cloudy when we arrived, it only got sunny towards the end of filming, so apologies for the variation of sun/light levels in the clips, it''s a bit inconsistent! never the less, it was a super super fun day and the Mavic was a charm!

Check out my footage of the Mourne Mountains, Co Down: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ObG5pPuJTxE&t=6s

Music: Jeff Kaale  https://soundcloud.com/jeff-kaale
author: Jamie Mul
